sources.title: DevelopersMatrix - AI Automation Agency Pricing 2026
sources.content: AI automation agency pricing in 2026 runs $800 to $45,000 per project and $500 to $6,000 per month on retainer. A simple single step workflow sits at the bottom of that range. A full autonomous agent system sits at the top. The agencies charging at the top are not doing more work. They price on the value delivered to the client, not the hours spent building. A common approach is to price the work at 20 to 40 percent of the client first year value from the automation.

sources.title: Ciela AI - Most Profitable AI Automation Agency Niches 2026
sources.content: We analyzed data from over 400 AI automation agencies to rank the 12 most profitable niches by revenue potential, competition level, average deal size, and ease of delivery. Top niches by monthly retainer: Med spas and healthcare practices 90% of agencies hit $3k+/mo; Dental practices 80% hit $3k+/mo; Home services (HVAC, plumbing, electrical) 70% hit $3k+/mo; Insurance agencies 65% hit $3k+/mo. Med spa industry has grown to over $18 billion in the US alone, with more than 8,000 med spa locations growing at 14 percent annually. Each location generates $1 to $3 million in annual revenue, meaning they have both the budget and the motivation to invest in AI automation.
